reasoning_chain: CHAIN: T lymphocytes -> part of adaptive immunity -> 95%
enhanced_information: T lymphocytes are indeed part of adaptive immunity. This is supported by the fact that T lymphocytes interact with vaccines, leading to the activation of adaptive immunity. Therefore, T lymphocytes are a crucial component of adaptive immunity.
analysis: T lymphocytes are a well-established component of adaptive immunity. They play a crucial role in the specific immune response by recognizing and targeting specific antigens. Complement, lysozyme, and polymorphonuclear leukocytes are part of the innate immune system, while T lymphocytes are part of the adaptive immune system.
